# PulsingLabs

> PulsingLabs is a Pakistani health app for booking blood tests at home. A phlebotomist from a licensed partner laboratory collects the sample at the patient's home, and results arrive in the app with plain-language explanations based on the patient's age and sex. Based in Karachi, Pakistan.

## Packages and prices (PKR, home sample collection included)

- Standard check-up, PKR 9,999, 12 tests: pulse, blood pressure (systolic and diastolic), haemoglobin, RBC, WBC, platelets, random blood sugar, total cholesterol, SGPT (ALT), creatinine, calcium.
- Premium check-up, PKR 16,999, 23 tests: everything in Standard plus HbA1c, LDL, HDL, LDL/HDL ratio, triglycerides, ferritin, ESR, TSH, vitamin D, Anti-HCV and HBsAg (hepatitis C and B screening).

## How it works

1. Choose Standard or Premium in the PulsingLabs app.
2. Pick a date and time for the home visit and pay in the app (card or wallet).
3. A phlebotomist collects the sample at home; a licensed partner lab tests it.
4. Results appear in the app on colour-coded charts, with explanations tuned to age and sex, and an AI assistant that answers questions about them in English or Urdu.

## Also

- Family: add parents, children and a spouse to one account; each gets their own Health ID and age-aware ranges.
- Privacy: results are private to the patient; companies only ever see anonymised group statistics.
- Companies: a corporate wellness plan with an HR dashboard (PKR 1,500 per active employee per month after a 30-day free trial).
- The AI explains results; it does not diagnose or prescribe, and it points urgent symptoms to emergency services.
